notes: 'yes, I'll dial in' accepts the deploy-call request and is an alternate quote for that item: an item quoting either matches it, and a second item for the other one is a duplicate (extra).

items.title: Pick Marcus up at JFK
items.quote: no problem, I'll pick you up tonight at 1
items.note: T-D2: 1:00 AM Thu Oct 22 EDT (05:00Z), inferred with the AM/PM line. 0.95 (modal).

items.title: Join the deploy call
items.quote: can you be on the deploy call Friday night at 2?
items.note: Friday night at 2 = 2:00 AM Sat Oct 24 EDT (06:00Z), inferred. 0.90. Alternate: the user's acceptance names the same loop. It carries no date of its own, so an item quoting only it gets a date miss.
